# appmixer_component (Resource)

Publishes an Appmixer component from a local zip file. The component is identified by its `selector` (dot-separated identifier). Changes to the zip file (detected via SHA256 hash) trigger a re-publish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Publish a component from a zip file built elsewhere in the repository.
resource "appmixer_component" "invoice_parser" {
  selector = "acme.billing.InvoiceParser"
  source   = "${path.module}/dist/invoice-parser.zip"
}

# Replace every previously published version of the component instead of
# adding a new one alongside them.
resource "appmixer_component" "legacy_exporter" {
  selector    = "acme.billing.LegacyExporter"
  source      = "${path.module}/dist/legacy-exporter.zip"
  replace_all = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `selector` (String) Dot-separated component identifier. Changes force replacement.
- `source` (String) Path to the component zip file.

### Optional

- `replace_all` (Boolean) Whether to replace all existing versions of the component. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `file_hash` (String) SHA256 hash of the source zip file. Changes trigger an update.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `published_at` (String) Timestamp from the upload response indicating when the component was published.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import appmixer_component.example acme.billing.InvoiceParser
```
